name: Congressional Leadership Fund
summary: House Republicans' main super PAC, founded in 2011 and tied to the House GOP leadership (Boehner, then Ryan; today it is the super PAC endorsed by Speaker Mike Johnson). It shares its leadership with the American Action Network, a nonprofit that does not disclose donors and supplied about 27% of its 2026 money. It raised more than $163 million for the 2026 cycle by June 30, 2026.
